topic: Frontend hiring and analytics data review
summary_markdown:
The conversation covered two main topics: staffing and analytics data. Regarding staffing, a potential frontend developer with 7 years of experience in HTML/CSS, Invision, Figma, and JavaScript was recommended as superior to an experienced JS/TS coder who might produce complex but imperfect code. A meeting is scheduled to discuss this candidate.

In terms of analytics, the discussion focused on checking changes for a mall location (UK). It was confirmed that changes should be checked in both the data source and Mops. The current staging dashboard link provided by [p1] did not show expected dwell-time changes, suggesting the need to check different date ranges or use the production dataset.
decisions: A meeting will be scheduled with the recommended frontend candidate, Galina, and someone else.
Changes for the mall location (UK) must be verified in both the data source and Mops.
action_items: Check dwell-time changes using different date ranges or confirming the use of the production dataset.
